topic: QOPI breast cancer metric compliance
standard: ASCO Quality Oncology Practice Initiative (QOPI) 84 breast cancer related metrics; local target 80% documentation of 13 identified achievable metrics
finding: 40/84 QOPI metrics met; of the 44 unmet, 13 were 'done/not documented' and 31 were 'not done/not documented'
change: Multidisciplinary QI team, Microsoft Word medical record template, new 'first time visit' model, monthly PDSA cycles from August-December 2018

detail.setting: Single breast cancer centre, Hospital Zambrano Hellion, Monterrey

cycle1.result: 40/84 QOPI metrics met; of the 44 unmet, 13 were 'done/not documented' and 31 were 'not done/not documented'

detail.intervention: Multidisciplinary QI team, Microsoft Word medical record template, new 'first time visit' model, monthly PDSA cycles from August-December 2018

detail.other_findings: The centre is now targeting the remaining 40/84 metrics to fully adhere to breast cancer QOPI standards; first Mexican breast cancer centre pursuing QOPI compliance.

title: Improving the referral rate of universal genetic counseling for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) at the Cleveland Clinic Taussig Cancer Center: A quality improvement project.
topic: Genetic counselling referral rate for pancreatic cancer
standard: 2018 ASCO/NCCN guidelines recommending genetic counselling and germline testing for all pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patients; local target 60% referral rate
finding: Baseline discussion rate 25% and referral rate 9%
change: Three PDSA cycles: updated electronic order/tumour board template, physician education, and patient education with physician reinforcement

cycle1.result: Baseline discussion rate 25% and referral rate 9%

detail.intervention: Three PDSA cycles: updated electronic order/tumour board template, physician education, and patient education with physician reinforcement

cycle2.result: Discussion and referral rates improved to 55%/30% after PDSA1, 73%/33% after PDSA2, and 95%/58% after PDSA3
